post.youtube_title: Rhino file to render in one click: bridal set
post.caption:
A bridal set, rendered from Rhino with the free HeyGema plug-in: press HeyGema on the toolbar, pick the metal and render.

Install it in Rhino: type PackageManager, search heygema and click Install.
How it works: https://www.heygema.com/en/rhino?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=yt-rhino-bridal-set
